new_entities.name: Component mounted on the external surface

obligations.subject: e2
obligations.response: no Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall refuse to grant approval under this Regulation as amended by the 04 series of amendments
obligations.ears: When the 04 series of amendments has officially entered into force, no Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall refuse to grant approval under this Regulation as amended by the 04 series of amendments.

obligations.subject: e2
obligations.response: shall not be obliged to accept type approvals to the preceding series of amendments, first issued after 1 September 2022
obligations.ears: As from 1 September 2022, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not be obliged to accept type approvals to the preceding series of amendments, first issued after 1 September 2022.

obligations.subject: e2
obligations.response: shall continue to accept type approvals issued according to the preceding series of amendments to this Regulation first issued before 1 September 2022
obligations.ears: Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall continue to accept type approvals issued according to the preceding series of amendments to this Regulation first issued before 1 September 2022.

obligations.subject: e2
obligations.response: shall not refuse to grant type approvals according to any preceding series of amendments to this Regulation or extensions thereof
obligations.ears: Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not refuse to grant type approvals according to any preceding series of amendments to this Regulation or extensions thereof.

obligations.subject: e5
obligations.response: Drawings of the necessary sections through the external surface shall be provided by the manufacturer to allow the height of the projections referred to above to be measured
obligations.ears: The manufacturer shall provide drawings of the necessary sections through the external surface to allow the height of the projections referred to above to be measured.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: may be determined either directly or by reference to a drawing of an appropriate section of this component in its installed condition
obligations.ears: When a component is mounted on a convex surface, the dimension of the projection of the component may be determined either directly or by reference to a drawing of an appropriate section of this component in its installed condition.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: it shall be determined by the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel when the sphere is moved over and is in constant contact with that component
obligations.ears: If the dimension of the projection of a component which is mounted on a surface other than convex cannot be determined by simple measurement, the dimension shall be determined by the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel when the sphere is moved over and is in constant contact with that component.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be measured horizontally from the point of contact of a 100 mm diameter sphere as shown in Figure 4
obligations.ears: The projection from the external surface of the headlamp shall be measured horizontally from the point of contact of a 100 mm diameter sphere as shown in Figure 4.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be determined by the distance between two planes passing through the points of contact of the sphere and perpendicular to the line joining those points of contact
obligations.ears: The dimension of a gap or space between elements of a grille shall be determined by the distance between two planes passing through the points of contact of the sphere and perpendicular to the line joining those points of contact.
